The word "unmarked" is mentioned two or more times in 0.0% of neuroscience papers' Results sections, as of 2020-2024.

Among 2020-2024 papers containing "unmarked" , 33.1% of reported significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) - i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This rate is similar to median Psychology paper (shown in black); relative to other words, papers with "unmarked" are in the bottom 49th percentile of fragile p-value percentages (lower = better). Note, strong/weak p-values highly predict replicability.
